digest.component_or_area: plan-review T10 overlay rubric and eval spec
propositions: T10 rubric must partition durable (persistent IaC/config) from transient (throwaway de-risk experiments) in a scope clause near the top
The four MAJOR safety classes (destructive-apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, untrusted-network endpoint-auth) must remain in scope for transient infrastructure despite the general exclusion
T10 rubric must be independent and not name or delegate scope to T15 or other overlays
A packaged eval spec with ten balanced dataset cases (five pass, five finding) must validate the scope partition while preserving safety-class coverage
Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause, exact co-located safety qualifier, and rubric independence assertions

The strict packaged-spec registration and live criterion-eval with 3 runs must confirm all ten cases (throwaway probes, durable infra, private transient, secret-manager transient, sandboxed teardown pass; under-specified durable, destructive transient, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext-secret, untrusted-network transient finding)
